nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Frontend POSTs multipart/form-data here. Fields: resume (file), locations (JSON string), roles (JSON string), salaryMin, salaryMax.

nodes.name: Extract Resume Text
nodes.notes: Calls Firebase extractResume function. Set FIREBASE_EXTRACT_URL in n8n > Settings > Variables.

nodes.name: Search Jobs
nodes.notes: Calls Firebase searchJobs function. Handles OpenAI profile summarization + SerpAPI + Naukri scraping internally. Set FIREBASE_SEARCH_URL in n8n > Settings > Variables.
